# Ludo Clans

> Official offline-first 3D tabletop board game for Android by Alphanor Studios.

## Official Download
- **Google Play Store:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ludoclans.game
- **Package ID:** `com.ludoclans.game`
- **Official Website:** https://ludo-clans-website.vercel.app/
- **Support:** ludoclanshelp@duck.com

## Overview
Ludo Clans combines classic 15x15 Ludo and 100-Tile Snakes & Ladders with collectible 3D hero squads, tactile 3D dice physics, smart offline AI bots, and 2-4 player Pass & Play on a single device—with zero forced mid-match ads.

## Launch Clans & Modes
- **Clans:** Cyber Knights, Starlight Idols, Emerald Drakes, Storm Shinobi, Crystal Royalty (Cyber Knights and Starlight Idols unlocked free at launch).
- **Modes:** Pass & Play (2-4 players), Vs Smart Bot AI (Casual & Competitive), 100-Tile Snakes & Ladders, Classic Fast & Fantasy FX modes.
